period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary half-yearly interim financial statements ("Half Yearly Report 2012", statements for the half year ended 30 June 2012 (Unaudited)). This copy is a scanned booklet (page numbers 07-08 visible) rather than a native-text PDF; figures were read visually from high-resolution page crops. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2012' / 'Profit & Loss Account for the half year ended 30 June 2012') figures are used, not 'Consolidated'. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 104,934.40m + Total equity 18,791.55m = Total assets 123,725.95m exactly; every P&L subtotal from Profit before provision (1,805.88m) down to Net profit after tax (784.29m) reconciles exactly. This filing's own 2011 comparative column (interest income 4,160,390,061; net interest income 2,017,053,786; investment income 535,049,087; net profit after tax 995,045,958 -- all Year-to-Date-2011) matches the independently-sourced 2011_Q2.json figures exactly, and its Dec-2011 balance-sheet comparative (total assets 115,735,967,684; total equity 17,855,918,166) matches the independently-sourced 2012_Q1.json figures exactly -- strong cross-validation of both filings. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in this primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap.
